description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and documentation for the Non-volatile Storage (NVS) subsystem in Zephyr OS, including the nvs_fs structure and APIs for mounting, clearing, reading, writing, and deleting entries in NVS.

methods.name: nvs_mount
methods.description: Mounts an NVS filesystem onto the specified flash device.

methods.name: nvs_clear
methods.description: Clears the NVS filesystem from flash.

methods.name: nvs_write
methods.description: Writes an entry to the NVS filesystem.

methods.name: nvs_delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the NVS filesystem.

methods.name: nvs_read
methods.description: Reads an entry from the NVS filesystem.

methods.name: nvs_read_hist
methods.description: Reads a historical entry from the NVS filesystem.

methods.name: nvs_calc_free_space
methods.description: Calculates free space in the NVS filesystem.
